Alkat Sp ZOO Appoints New Chief Operating Officer to Drive Growth in Poland's Utilities Sector

Alkat Sp ZOO, a prominent player in Poland’s Gas & Water Utilities industry, has appointed Anna Kowalska as its new Chief Operating Officer, effective July 1. The appointment comes as the company seeks to strengthen its operational efficiency and expand its market share amid a rapidly evolving energy landscape in Central Europe.

Kowalska brings over 20 years of experience in utility operations and infrastructure management, having previously held senior roles at several regional energy companies. In her new position, she will oversee Alkat Sp ZOO’s nationwide network of gas and water distribution, focusing on process optimisation, customer service, and digital transformation.

“We are delighted to welcome Anna Kowalska to our leadership team,” said Jan Nowak, Chief Executive Officer of Alkat Sp ZOO, in a statement. “Her extensive track record in operational excellence and her understanding of the regulatory environment make her an ideal fit as we continue to invest in modernising our infrastructure and improving service reliability for our customers.”

Poland’s utilities sector has seen significant investment in recent years, driven by the country’s commitment to upgrading aging infrastructure and aligning with European Union regulations on sustainability and efficiency. According to the Polish Gas & Water Association, capital outlays in the sector increased by 8% in 2023, with companies directing resources toward digital metering, leak detection, and emission reduction initiatives.

Analysts welcomed the appointment, noting Kowalska’s strong background in overseeing large-scale utility projects. “Alkat Sp ZOO has a solid reputation for service delivery, and Ms. Kowalska’s appointment signals an ambition to further raise operational standards,” said Marek Zielinski, Utilities Analyst at the Warsaw-based research firm CentralPol Insights. “Her prior experience in integrating new technologies and driving workforce engagement will likely benefit Alkat’s ongoing digitalisation agenda.”

As part of her remit, Kowalska will lead efforts to streamline Alkat Sp ZOO’s supply chain, enhance customer communication channels, and support the company’s sustainability objectives. Industry observers suggest that her arrival could accelerate projects aimed at reducing water loss and modernising gas pipelines in key regions.

In an internal note to employees, Kowalska emphasised her commitment to collaboration and innovation. “I look forward to working with the talented team at Alkat Sp ZOO to build on our strong foundation and deliver the best possible service to our communities,” she wrote.

Alkat Sp ZOO, headquartered in Łódź, serves both residential and commercial customers across Poland. The company reported a 6% year-on-year increase in revenues for 2023, driven by steady demand and infrastructure upgrades. With the new leadership in place, Alkat Sp ZOO aims to reinforce its position as a reliable partner in Poland’s utility sector.
